description: First launch guides the user through entering and validating a FRED API key before opening the workspace.
steps: Launch the app without an API key
See onboarding instructions and API key entry
Test and save a valid API key
Transition into the main workspace

description: Users can search FRED series, browse results, and select a series in a stable macOS sidebar workflow.
steps: Enter a search term in the sidebar
Receive result rows with key series metadata
Select a result
See the detail dashboard update for that series

description: Favorites, recent searches, and API settings persist locally between app sessions.
steps: Favorite a series
Run at least one search
Reopen the app or refresh the relevant views
Confirm the saved state is preserved

description: Series detail shows charting, data tables, and useful calculated insights without runtime or formatting errors.
steps: Open a series detail view
Inspect overview metrics and calculated insights
Switch between chart, data, and analysis surfaces
Confirm the displayed metrics are coherent with the dataset

description: Users can compare multiple series and see sane handling when units differ.
steps: Open a primary series
Add an additional series for comparison
Inspect the combined chart and normalization messaging
Remove a comparison series cleanly

description: Users can export current observations to CSV/JSON and copy values to the clipboard.
steps: Open a populated series
Export data as CSV
Export data as JSON
Copy the visible dataset to the clipboard

description: Settings and README clearly explain app setup, capabilities, and operational limits.
steps: Open Settings
Validate API key guidance and data management actions
Read the README
Confirm the documentation matches the current app behavior

description: The project builds and the available tests run cleanly from the command line.
steps: Run the build command
Run the test command
Confirm there are no compile errors
Confirm test failures are resolved or explicitly documented
